info.title: tasmota-power
info.description: Tasmota MQTT smart plug control and monitoring per printer.

get.summary: Get Tasmota plug config, live power state, and safety lock status for a printer
get.description: Returns the printer's configured Tasmota MQTT topic, live relay/power telemetry, active-print safety lock state, and auto-off countdown.

put.summary: Configure Tasmota MQTT topic and auto-off settings for a printer
put.description: Persists the printer's Tasmota MQTT topic, auto-off-after-print flag, and optional cooldown duration.

post.summary: Turn a printer's Tasmota plug ON, OFF, or TOGGLE
post.description: Publishes ON or OFF to cmnd/<topic>/Power via MQTT. Refuses OFF or TOGGLE-to-OFF with 409 Conflict if the printer is actively printing or busy.

200.description: Command sent and updated plug status

post.summary: Arm or disarm automatic power-off when the current print finishes
post.description: Enables or disables one-shot automatic power-off after the current print finishes and the cooldown period elapses.
